slides.texte_overlay:
how i finally got every school subject
plus my own little tricks

Earth sciences
look at real places, not just diagrams.
my trick: find each rock or landform on a map.

Computer science
type the code yourself, never copy-paste.
my trick: break the program on purpose and fix it.

Latin
find the verb first, then everything else.
my trick: spot latin roots in english words.

Music
listen before you analyse.
my trick: learn the story of one composer a week.

Civics
link each rule to a real situation.
my trick: ask "who decides this, and how?"

Spanish grammar
learn verbs in short sentences, not lists.
my trick: 3 sentences about my day, every evening.
